entry_state: The representation now separates immutable observations,contextual mappings,dated company relationships and eligible source views. Extraction,translation,model admission and accounting eligibility are distinct decisions. The JPMorgan wrong-reference example has introduced conflicting printed targets156 and163; its inspection and correction continue next.
exit_state: The historical record now has explicit source-admission,rounding,information-view and dependency rules. A corrected interpretation changes eligible calculations while preserving the old explanation and committed events;posting a correction still needs accounting treatment. The literature chapter must now explain which established methods supply these capabilities and which design work remains.
findings: The wrong-reference example rejects156 as the auditor report's start while preserving it as the literal Item15 statement. Search scope and candidate-selection dependencies change without automatically invalidating unrelated financial amounts.

Coverage populations remain separate,and retained PDF/HTML differences prevent a false missing-source diagnosis. Nearest-rounding bounds are conditional;truncation supplies a different interval and unknown convention supplies no automatic half-unit constraint.

The availability timeline distinguishes excluded,unresolved and supported intervals. Later ingestion can coexist with earlier public availability;accepted system views additionally need timely review decisions.

Bank commitment and reinsurance ordering examples separate knowledge dates from economic baseline/timing. The dependency discussion preserves original explanations and exact retry receipts;unsupported correction treatment creates no journal. No confirmed new defect.
